metaDescription: New Martinsville, Wetzel County seat mineral owners: core Marcellus courthouse records, dense unit development, and multi-heir farm-tract interests.
heroLead: New Martinsville is the Wetzel County seat, sitting at the center of some of the thickest, most active Marcellus acreage in West Virginia.
intro: The Wetzel County Courthouse in New Martinsville holds the deed and lease record for a county widely regarded as core Marcellus territory, and the town itself sits along the Ohio River amid consistent horizontal development on the surrounding farmland.

sections.heading: County-seat access to a dense drilling record
paragraphs: Because New Martinsville houses the courthouse, tracing a Wetzel County mineral interest starts here regardless of where in the county the tract actually sits. Given the volume of leasing and pooling activity across the county over the past fifteen-plus years, expect the record to involve multiple lease assignments and unit filings even for a single tract.

sections.heading: Farm-tract ownership and multi-heir splits
paragraphs: Much of the acreage around New Martinsville was originally held in family farm tracts, many of which have split among multiple heirs over the generations since. Pooling into modern horizontal units doesn't consolidate those heir splits — each heir's fractional share carries forward into their portion of the unit royalty.

sections.heading: Confirming operator of record before assuming payment terms
paragraphs: With Wetzel County's leasing history running as deep as it does, the company currently paying royalties on a New Martinsville-area tract isn't always the one whose name appears on the original lease your family signed. Assignments between operators are common and don't require the mineral owner's consent, only proper recording.
Before assuming your royalty is calculated on outdated terms, it's worth pulling the current operator's division order and comparing it against your original lease's stated percentage.

faqs.question: Why is New Martinsville a good starting point for Wetzel County title research?
faqs.answer: As the county seat, its courthouse holds the county's full deed, will, and lease record, which is where any title chain in Wetzel County has to be traced from.

faqs.question: How many lease assignments should I expect to find on a New Martinsville-area tract?
faqs.answer: Potentially several, given how much leasing activity Wetzel County has seen. It's worth confirming the current operator of record rather than assuming your original lease is still with the original signing company.

faqs.question: My family's farm tract near New Martinsville has many heirs — can we each sell separately?
faqs.answer: Yes, each heir's fractional share can be sold independently.

faqs.question: Can an operator change my royalty rate when they take over a lease by assignment?
faqs.answer: No, an assignment transfers the existing lease's obligations to the new operator; your royalty percentage stays governed by the original lease terms unless properly amended.
